title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Special Financing Terms: Deferred Interest Promotions
content:
**Qualification.** A Marlowe & Finch purchase charged to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account (one order number) is placed on special financing — the 12-month or the 18-month deferred interest plan, matching the card's promotion length — when the merchandise in that order whose purchase records' merchandise class is one of the card's eligible classes totals at least the card's smallest eligible purchase. The whole charge is then promotional, and separate orders are never combined to reach the minimum. Gift card, beauty and fragrance, and outside-merchant purchases never qualify.

**Account condition.** The account is in active status, as the company's account record shows.

**During and after the promotion.** During the promotion no interest is charged on that purchase. If the promotional purchase is paid in full by the end of the promotion, which is the payment due date of the statement for the billing period that closes the card's promotion length in full calendar months after the purchase date (the same day of the month, or the last day of a shorter month), no interest is ever charged on it. If any of it remains unpaid after that date, deferred interest is charged on the next statement closing date for the whole promotional amount from the purchase date, at the card's purchase APR, pointing to the promotional purchase.

**Credits.** A merchandise credit for the promotional purchase reduces the promotional balance first and is treated as paid.

## Qualification cases (hypothetical card: smallest eligible purchase USD 999.00, eligible class Furniture & Mattresses)

| Order | Eligible-class merchandise in the order | Placed on special financing |
|---|---|---|
| a sofa USD 600.00 and a chair USD 450.00, one order, plus a lamp of another class | USD 1050.00 | yes, the whole charge including the lamp |
| a sofa USD 600.00 in one order and a chair USD 450.00 in another | USD 600.00 and USD 450.00 | no; orders are never combined |
| a mattress USD 999.00 | USD 999.00 | yes |
| fragrance sets totalling USD 1200.00 | none | no |

## Month counting (hypothetical purchase dates)

Twelve full calendar months after a purchase dated 10 March is 10 March of the next year; eighteen full calendar months after a purchase dated 31 August falls in February, a shorter month, and so on its last day.

## Outcome at the end (hypothetical USD 1200.00 promotional purchase)

Paid in full by the end of the promotion: no interest is ever charged. USD 50.00 still unpaid after that date: deferred interest is charged on the next statement closing date on the whole USD 1200.00 from the purchase date.
